## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The README still documents the old 30-second default, so it now contradicts the CLI. That stale line is the one change this review asks for; the existing override and invalid-input tests still cover the parser paths around the new default.

## Changes
This pull request raises `DEFAULT_TIMEOUT` in `app/cli.py` from 30 to 60 seconds and updates `test_defaults` to expect 60. It also adds a one-line `review.txt` file at the repository root.

## Important
- app/cli.py:3 — comments — Update README timeout default to 60 seconds — When you run the CLI without `--timeout`, it now waits 60 seconds, but `README.md:3` still says "Requests time out after 30 seconds unless you pass `--timeout SECONDS`." The README is not part of this diff, so the text stays stale. — Users and operators who read the README will plan around a 30-second timeout that the tool no longer uses.
